basic_profile.bio: A seasoned vaper and DIY enthusiast hailing from Portland, Oregon. When I'm not chasing clouds, I'm usually experimenting with new recipes in the kitchen or catching up on the latest MMORPGs. I'm a night owl, typically online during late evenings to early mornings. Currently working as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me the flexibility to indulge in my eclectic hobbies. In a long-term relationship with my high school sweetheart, who shares my love for parrots.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have over a decade of experience in vaping, starting with basic mods and gradually moving to building custom RDTAs. My expertise is largely self-taught, supplemented by online forums, YouTube tutorials, and trial and error. I also have a background in graphic design, having studied it in college and worked in the field since.
